owner_and_capability: Root composition (server root api, the HTTP host of ADR 0056) mounts the operator routes of Identity & Access, Organisation & Tenancy, Settings Platform, Communication and Device Fleet: the operator router of api/operator is cross-owner glue and moves into api as operatorRouter, with each owner's part as its own value (ADR 0059 point 1). The fifth package of #4064.
affected_tables: None: code-only package move, no database tables or DDL affected.
atomic_cutover: One PR, no policy epoch change. api/operator/api.go becomes api/operator_routes.go: operator.Resource and operator.ResourceConfig, which held values of several owners, are replaced by operatorRouter, which takes the Identity & Access inputs (operatorIdentity, one owner), Organisation & Tenancy's ProvisioningConfig and BillingResource, Settings Platform's SettingsResource, the Communication capability, the Device Fleet handler and the root's authRateLimiters; IdentityResponses becomes operatorIdentityResponses. api/base.go builds them in newOperatorRouter. The router suites move into api as api/operator_*_test.go; only the router construction and the panic text for missing session chains change. The owner inbound-operator, its package entry and its eight rules are deleted; the root reaches every import through the standing ADR 0053 point 2 reaches. One #2750 key falls (520 -> 519); routes, status codes, error bodies and middleware chains are unchanged; the composition surface falls from 1746 to 1743.
